:::{#exm-partial-sum}
#### Partial sums of halves

For $a_i = 1/2^i$, the sequence $\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{4}, \frac{1}{8}, \ldots$,
the first three partial sums are
$s_1 = \frac{1}{2}$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
s_2 &= \frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{4} \\
&= \frac{3}{4},
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
s_3 &= \frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{8} \\
&= \frac{7}{8}.
\end{aligned}
$$

In general, $s_n = 1 - 1/2^n$.

:::
